trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied post-login 'redirect' value is a same-origin path; at the pinned commit nothing decides it: initiate stores it raw in the OIDC state store and the callback 302s to it verbatim (the fix adds isSafeRedirect/safeRedirectOrRoot at each read).

landing_point.why: The advisory title names the OIDC initiation endpoint; the GET handler reads ?redirect= there with no validation.

fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP route handler reading state saved by another request (save/reload)

fix_sites.entry_point: /login?redirect= page (client goto at :94/:121, SSO hand-off at :136-137)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/routes/api/auth/oidc/callback/+server.ts:58-59 sink reads stateData.redirectUrl stored at src/lib/server/auth.ts:1270-1276 and returned at src/lib/server/auth.ts:1494; also the client page src/routes/login/+page.svelte:35

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The callback only replays a value the server itself stored, so a solver who validates at initiate can argue the callback is already safe and skip it (and argue the login page is client-only and that SvelteKit goto refuses external URLs).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Deep-link return after login: the auth guard sends unauthenticated users to /login?redirect=<pathname+search>, so path-relative targets with query strings (e.g. /containers?env=2) must still round-trip through local login and the OIDC initiate->callback flow; an over-broad fix that resets everything to '/' or drops the query breaks it.

O6_input_shapes: non-string value (JSON body.redirect as number/object/array in POST)
missing or empty value (falls back to '/')

O7_producer.where: src/lib/server/auth.ts:1165-1171 in-memory oidcStateStore written in buildOidcAuthorizationUrl at src/lib/server/auth.ts:1270-1276; read back at src/lib/server/auth.ts:1307 and returned at :1494

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Wire the exported, currently uncalled buildOidcLogoutUrl into /api/auth/logout with a caller-supplied post-logout return target.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: An OIDC single-logout helper already exists with a postLogoutRedirectUri parameter and no caller; a maintainer finishing SSO logout would plausibly pass ?redirect= through it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A local/LDAP login JSON response returning a server-chosen redirect taken from the request body.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The login page already carries redirectUrl next to the credential POST; moving the redirect decision server-side is a common refactor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second caller of buildOidcAuthorizationUrl (e.g. an API-token or CLI-triggered SSO start) that passes the raw value, since the lower-level API itself does not validate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The function is exported and takes redirectUrl as a free parameter with no validation of its own.

O9_family: open redirect (CWE-601) in post-login return URL

O10_build.project_tests: package.json:15-52 references bun tests under tests/ (incl. test:auth tests/auth-settings.test.ts) and Playwright e2e, but no tests/ directory exists at the pinned commit; nothing covers redirect handling.
